vya_text: dI0 - atha pAcanamAha - pacatyAmamityAdi | yaddravyamAmaM pacati vahniM na kuryAt tat pAcanaM j~jeyam | atrApi dravyapraBAvo boddhavyaH | tacca nAgakeSaravadvidyAjjAnIyAt | yataH `nAgakeSarakaM rUkShamuShNaM laGvAmapAcanam' iti | AmapAcanamiti virUkShaNam | sAmAnAM doShadhAtumalAnAmityeke | uBayAtmakamAha - citro dIpanapAcana iti | citraka uBayakAryakaro Bavati | dIpanaH pAcanaSca | taduktam - 'citrakaH kaTukaH pAke vahnikRutpAcano laGuH |' iti || 1 ||

gU0 – yat (dravyaM) AmaM pacati vahniM na kuryAt tatpAcanam | tadAha citraH citrakaH, nAgakeSaravaddIpanapAcanaM vidyAt jAnIyAt granthAntarAt mAdhuryAcCItaBAvAcca na punardIpano mataH | yatkAmaM pAcanaM kuryAt tattu dIpanamucyate ||1||

pada: pacatyAmaM na vahniM ca kuryAdyattaddhi pAcanam || 1 || nAgakeSaravadvidyAccitro dIpanapAcanaH |

vya_text: dI0 - atha saMSamanamAha - na SodhayatIti | yat ki~jcit pItalIDhASitamanirhRutya doShaM saMSamayati tat saMSamanam | etena kimuktaM yaddravyaM na vAmayati na virecayati iti vyAdhinA saha ekIBUya tatsthameva vyAdhimupaSamayati tat saMSamanamiti BAvaH | doShaSabdo ~atra doSheShu kAryavyAdhiShvapi vartate | kArye kAraNopacArAt | asamaM samaM karoti samIkaroti | yathA-amRutA guDUcI saMSamanI prasiddhA | taduktaM - ‘rasAyanI saMSamanI doShANAM jvaranASinI | guDUcI kaTukA laGvI tiktA ~agnidIpanI matA' iti | kecittu - ‘na Sodhayati yaddoShAn samAn nodIrayatyapi | samIkaroti ca kruddhAn tat saMSamanamucyate’ iti paThanti | atrApi sa evA ~aBiprAyaH | samyak SamayatIti saMSamanaM, samyag duShTadoShasyAnirharaNapUrvakaM SamanaM aduShTasyAnudIraNaM ca, vyAdhiSamane tu prastutavyAdhiSamanaM, aprastutavyAdheranudIraNamiti spaShTArthaj~jApanAya na doShaH || punarBAvakathanAt || 2 ||

gU0 - yaddravyaM uddhatAn varddhitAn doShAnna Sodhayati upaSamaM no nayati samAnsaprakRutisthAnna dveShTi na vardhayati kiMtu samIkaroti tat SamanaM j~jeyam | yathA amRutA guDUcI tadvadityarthaH || 2 ||

pada: na Sodhayati na dveShTi samAn doShAMstathoddhatAn ||2|| samIkaroti viShamA~jSamanaM tadyathA ~amRutA |

vya_text: dI0 - atha vamanamAha - apakvamiti | yaddravyamapakvaM pAkamagacCantaM pittaSleShmANaM vyastaM miSritaM vA balAt haThAtkAreNa UrdhvaM nayet muKe kRutvA vAmayedityaBiprAyaH | tadvamanaM vij~jeyaM yathA madanasya Palam | balAditi praBAvasUcakaSabdaH, yato vamanadravyANi vAyvagniguNaBUyiShThAni, vAyvagnI hi laGutvAcca tAnyUrdhvamuttiShThanti | laGutvaM ceha praBAvaviSeShAdhiShThitaM madanaPalAdidravyasamavetaM grAhyaM na tu laGutvamAtram, anyathA kapi~jjalalAjAdInAM ca vAmanIyatvaM syAt | nanu kaPasya vamanaM pittasya virecanaM praSastamiti prasiddhiH, tat kathaM pittasya vamanamiti ? ucyate -apakvapittasya vamanAdeva nibarhaNaM boddhavyam | tacca dRuSyate hi kaTutiktaharitpItAmlavamanatvena yataH pittadagdhamamlatAmupaitIti | ata evA ~amlapittacikitsAyAmAdau vamanamityadoShaH || 7 ||

gU0 – yaddravyam apakvaM pittaSleShmAnnacayam UrdhvaM nayet hi niScayena tat vamanaM vij~jeyam | yathA madanasya Palam, apakvaM pittaM ca apakvaH SleShmA ca apakvamannaM ca apakvapittaSleShmAnnAnAM cayam apakvapittaSleShmAnnacayam atra SleShman Sabdasya nakArasya lope yAte sati lope ~aSi punarna saMdhirityuktatvAt | sa ‘savarNe dIrGaH saha' ityanena sUtreNa pUrvAparavarNayormitho GaTanarUpasandhirna atra punargrahAdeva sandhiH, anyathA dAmodaDiShvityAdau sandhirna syAt | ato ~atra sandhiryukta eva || 7 ||

pada: apakvapittaSleShmANau balAdUrdhvaM nayettu yat || 7 || vamanaM taddhi vij~jeyaM madanasya PalaM yathA |

vya_text: dI0 - atha SodhanamAha - sthAnAditi | yaddravyaM sthAnAt prakupitasthAnAt malasa~jcayaM doShAdInAM svasthAnAdUrdhvamadho vA bahirnayet bahiH karoti taddehe SarIre SodhanaM kathitam | yathA devadAlIPalam | devadAlIvallIsaMj~jA | UrdhvaM muKanAsikAByAM, adhaH pAyumeDhramArgeNa | dehagrahaNena SoNitAvasecanamapi gRuhyate SodhanatvAt | yataH SodhanaM dvividhamAcakShate bahirASrayamaByantarASrayaM ca | tatra bahirASrayaM SastrakShArAgnipralepAdayaH | aByantarASrayaM tu catuHprakAraM vamanarecanAsthApanaSoNitamokShaNaM ca | eke SirovirecanaM manyante | taccAtra vamanAntarBUtaM boddhavyam, UrdhvaSodhanatvAt || 8 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha CedanamAha - SliShTAniti | yaddravyaM SliShTAn sa~jcitAn, parasparagrathitAnityeke, atyarthaM kupitAnityapare, kaPAdikAn doShAn, AdigrahaNena vAtapittaSoNitakRumigrahaNaM na tu dUShyadUShyatAdikaM, yataH doShAniti punargrahaNaM kRumiSoNitayorapi doShasaMj~jA | taduktaM suSrute ‘narte dehaH kaPAdasti na pittAnna ca mArutAt | SoNitAdapi vA nityaM deha etaistu dhAryate' ityAdipratipAditatvAt | kRumistu guggulukalpe yathA pa~jcAdidoShAn SamayedityAdipraSne kRumidoShanibarhaNAdityAdinA, tanmate kRumestu doShasaMj~jA | balAditi svaSaktitaH, unmUlayati ucCedayati, tacCedanaM j~jeyam | yathA kShArA yavakShArAdayaH, maricAnIti bahuvacanatvena Svetamaricamapi grAhyam | nanu vAtAdikramaM parityajya kaPAdikrameNa SlokaH kasmAdiha kRutaH ? taducyate, dehasya UrdhvamUlatvamadhaHSAKatvaM pratipAditaM pUrvAcAryaiH, UrdhvaBAge ca kaPAdhiShThAnatvAttato ~anena kaPa eva prathamaM darSitaH | taduktam - ‘UrdhvamUlamadhaHSAKaM tristhUNaM pa~jcadaivatam | kShetraj~jAdhiShThitaM vidvAn yo vai veda sa vedavit ' || 9 ||
